Please share..From Officer Kondek's widow
Wanted to find a positive way to celebrate Charlie's birthday & his love for life, giving, and our amazing country that he was so proud of so we are excited to do this! #BlueLivesMatter @SteveG717 @FLgoingblue https://t.co/vKbXEwdH8O

I wish that any First Responder struggling would reach out to someone. Many organizations are now at one's fingertips. For anyone struggling;It's okay to reach out..It's okay to just be human. Find someone to help you over this speed-bump #BlueLivesMatter https://t.co/5HxJc9IUx8
